<b>Cogwork Defenders</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are tall [[Cogwork Bugs|automatons]] wielding a shield and poke-pin. 

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Stands at attention, shuffling back and forth with its shield raised whilst idle. It tenses up slightly once it has detected Hornet.<br>
They keep their shields raised until after about 1.5 seconds or Hornet strikes their shield. They also raise their shield above themselves to defend against attacks from above if Hornet jumps above them. To counterattack, Cogwork Defenders have two moves:
* <b>Double Thrust:</b> Thrusts forwards with its poke-pin twice, moving forwards with each thrust.
* <b>Overhead Swing:</b> Starting from behind itself, does a large overhead swing that covers its entire body once. Only used if Hornet is above it when it is deciding to attack.

Cogwork Defenders deal {{Damage|1}} with their attacks as well as upon contact.

=== Strategies === 
The Cogwork Defender is vulnerable to attacks from above during either of its attacks. Hornet can stand in front of it to provoke a Double-Thrust, or she can remain above to provoke an overhead swing. Allowing the Cogwork Defender to start its attack first can make it easier to land a successful blow.

Alternatively, striking its shield and causing it to Double-Thrust, then jumping over it, attacking its uncovered back and repeating can easily dispatch them.

Certain {{CrestSlot|Red|s}} such as the [[Sting Shard]] are not blocked by the shield, and can be used for easy damage.

A cogwork defender and a cogwork cleanser can be hit through the floor in the platforming challenge to get the architect's melody for easy silk.

=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-Threading|Black-threaded]] Cogwork Defenders have their health doubled. They can gain any of the standard [[Black-Threading#Movesets|void attacks]].

== Location ==
Cogwork Defenders can be found in the [[Cogwork Core]], and two of them are fought as part of the [[Enemy Gauntlets (Silksong)/Cogwork Core 1|enemy gauntlet]] in the southwest of the area. After the fight, one of them can spawn upon each return to the arena.

== Trivia ==
* Sprites of deactivated Defenders have a grey tiara-like headpiece similar to [[Fourth Chorus]] and the [[Cogwork Dancers]]. This is also partly visible in their Hunter's Journal entry.
* Cogwork Defender's poke-pin heavily resembles a [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Seam_ripper seam ripper].
* Cogwork Defenders share their Needolin dialogue with [[Cogwork Choirbug]]s, [[Cogwork Cleanser]]s, [[Cogwork Clapper]]s, [[Cogworker]]s, [[Cogwork Spine]]s, [[Cogwork Crawler]]s, and [[Cogwork Underfly|Cogwork Underflies]].
** Additionally, they share their singing audio with [[Second Sentinel]].
